title: Jabberwocky
summary: A first-person dungeon crawler where the only weapon is the Jabberwocky rifle, and every pull of the trigger fires something different: a hail of knives, a frozen pie, a freight train, a life-sized city bus, a yak running backwards. Sixty-one things it can fire, four mazes of lizardmen, cultists, brutes and worse, and the Jabberwock in the middle with a rifle exactly like yours. Three lives. The ways out: three odd doors in every maze lit by cold blue flames, a hole of your own making, and a light when the lives run out.
